name: OL Shimai
source:
Main character is an engineer in a big IT company. He is secretly in love with his subordinate Ayaka. But one day he learns that Ayaka got engaged with another person from the same company. Protagonist is enraged and wants to quit this job, but first he decides to lure Ayaka to a remote country house and abduct her there to get his revenge.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-february-2004-forest.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是大型IT企业的一名工程师，一直暗恋着部下绫香。然而某天，他得知绫香已经与同公司的另一人订婚。怒不可遏的主人公想要辞职，但在那之前，他决定把绫香诱骗到偏僻的乡间别墅，将她绑架到那里实施报复。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-february-2004-forest.html]vndbreview[/url]]
